sources.title: Piracy monthly report April 2025
sources.text: Unauthorized persons in a boat came alongside the berthed ship. The duty AB noticed a person was trying to climb onboard via a rope. Seeing the AB, the person retreated to his boat and escaped. A broken padlock on the steering gear room door was discovered during inspection, but nothing was reported stolen.
